description: Open a URL in the session's browser and return the final URL and page title after redirects. In a supervised session the person watching sees the page. With no session_id and no active session, it creates an ordinary session that no one can watch or take over; call start_supervised_session first when a person may need to step in, for example to sign in. API docs: https://roveapi.com/docs.

page_id.description: The page to act on, from list_pages or pages_opened. Defaults to the current page. Does not change the current page.

session_id.description: Reuse an existing browser session. Omit to use the active session, or to create an ordinary session when there is none.

url.description: Full URL to open, including protocol (e.g. "https://example.com").

wait_until.description: Page lifecycle event to wait for. Default: "networkidle".

name: navigate
title: Open URL
